name: Yeung Kwun
source:
He was the previous head of the Red Flower Society.
He was the owner of the Amaryllis nightclub and several other nightclubs.
With his high charisma and the ability to accept even former undercover police officers and assassins, he has increased the power of the Red Flower Society.
He and Francis, who prefers to live a more serious life, do not get along well, but through Yvet, they gradually deepen their mutual understanding.
He is the one who gave Lycoris the name "Yvet" and suggested that Yvet take over the Red Flower Society.
He died of pancreatic cancer in 2013.
